prompts.panorama: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production panoramic environment texture for a Doom skybox, NOT a screenshot or mockup. Reference image defines the approved surrounding INFERNO ONLY. Generate a wide seamless 360-degree cylindrical panorama, 3:1 aspect ratio, horizon level and completely consistent scale across width, no vanishing-point composition. Left/right edges must join naturally. EXCLUDE every foreground gameplay object from reference: no floating islands, tower, castle, masonry, monsters, trees, crates, weapons, text or HUD. The entire image is just the far surrounding environment seen from high above an infernal abyss: enormous varied roaring orange/golden flame fronts wrapping around the world, sculpted charcoal and burnt-orange smoke billows, scattered towering black basalt spires and cliffs with thin bright lava waterfalls and several layers of atmospheric depth. Upper 55 percent is luminous FIRE and dark turbulent smoke, with tops of occasional distant spires; middle band at 55-70 percent distant jagged volcanic escarpments alternating with open fiery vistas, lower 30 percent a far-below cracked magma sea with branching golden-orange lava rivers, uneven dark crust and hot amber haze. Match the reference's fierce fire-dominant look, beautiful rich detail and orange/gold/charcoal palette. The flames remain the dominant backdrop, rocks secondary. Entire world continues past all image edges, no framing, no circular portal, no sun, no stars, no beam, no purple or blue. Panoramic game environment matte painting, crisp detailed textures, deep readable tonal range, preserve bright orange but avoid uniform blown-out yellow. ONE single continuous panorama.
prompts.magma: Production game environment texture, square 2048x2048, full-frame downward NADIR view of a colossal volcanic magma abyss. Reference is color/material style only. Camera looking STRAIGHT DOWN from very high above the lava field, orthographic-like aerial scale, no horizon, no sky, no perspective vanishing point. Complex branching rivers of incandescent golden-orange magma around irregular dark charcoal cooled crust plates, small sharp black basalt outcrops, scattered subtle amber steam and smoky wisps over the molten field. Extremely detailed realistic painted volcanic material, matching the fiery orange/gold/black reference. Mostly dark crust and richly orange lava, golden highlights limited to hot veins, no vast white areas. Uniform distant scale across entire square, avoid central focal point, no circular crater or sun. Tileable edges in both directions, no manmade objects, no islands with buildings, no text. This texture will fill the bottom of a game skybox, and must look like the floor of a very deep infernal chasm.
prompts.zenith: Production square seamless tileable fire-cloud texture for the overhead zenith of an infernal game skybox. Reference is only palette and appearance guidance. Camera looks straight upward into immense rolling clouds of charcoal and burnt-brown smoke shot through with vast billowing orange and golden FIRE, detailed tongues of flame, boiling smoke edges strongly lit from below. Fire LOOK dominant, varied dark smoke patches give depth and contrast. Entire frame is smoke and fire, no horizon, no mountains, no lava surface, no central vortex, no central hole, no beam, no stars, no sun, no scene objects or text. Matte-painted cinematic environment artwork, sculpted volumetric-looking smoke, sharp fine details, subtle larger structures, consistent distributed detail, no single focal point. Tileable in both axes, matching texture seamlessly wraps beyond the edges. Orange/amber/gold lights and near-black deep smoke, no purple or blue, no white overexposure. 2048 square if available.
